text:
Sam: Quick heads-up — final onsite loop for Alex M starts at 1:00pm PST today. Posting a short day-of runbook to make sure we don't miss anything.
Priya: Thanks — can someone confirm the interview room link and recording consent status?
Elena: Zoom link is in the calendar invite: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (passcode in event). I added myself to calendar.
RecruiterBot: RecruiterBot: candidate_consent_recording: yes — signed on candidate intake form at 2026-03-10T09:12Z.
Asha: Good — I'm covering systems design. Can we paste the short debrief template here so folks don't hunt Notion after?
Priya: Pasting the minimal debrief we want filled (1–2 bullets each) — please keep it short and score 1-5 on the three axes: impact, depth, communication.
Priya: ```
Debrief template (paste into Notion under candidate page):
- Overall recommendation: (Hire / No Hire / Hire with concerns)
- Impact (1-5): single-sentence justification
- Depth of technical reasoning (1-5): single-sentence justification
- Communication & collaboration (1-5): single-sentence justification
- Riskiest unknown / follow-up question for hiring manager
```
Elena: Quick rubric clarifier — for "Impact" think about past product outcomes, not just code size. If they drove a release that changed metrics, that should be a 5.
Asha: For "Depth" include whether they could reason about system tradeoffs under constraints (cost/latency/security).
Sam: Logistics checklist for today (copy/paste as reminder):
- Join Zoom 5m early and mute mic until candidate intro
- Confirm recording is on and candidate consent shown in chat
- Keep notes in candidate Notion page (link in calendar)
- Submit debrief within 24h and tag @recruiting
- If you need to swap last-minute, ping me (Sam) and @Priya ASAP

Priya: Also: do not include salary or private notes in the public debrief — use private candidate comments section.
Asha: Small ask — can someone grab the whiteboard link after the loop? I want to screenshot the design sketch for the hiring packet.
Elena: I'll export whiteboard and put the link on the Notion page.
RecruiterBot: Reminder sent to panel 15 minutes before start.
Sam: One more: if you see any major red flags (plagiarism, cannot follow basic prompt, toxic behavior) escalate to @Priya and @People-Ops and mark "No Hire" with notes.
Priya: I'll set a calendar follow-up to nudge debriefs at +20h if anyone hasn't submitted.
Asha: Thanks everyone — see you on the call. :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks — we're green.
